head: Orbit app launcher for iPhone puts your apps on a 3D wheel
dek: Orbit: Quick Launch Wheel is a $2.99 app launcher for iPhone that lines up the apps you open most on a spinning 3D wheel you flick and tap. It came out on 20 November and was #49 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 21 November.
details: You can build separate wheels, for example for work, home or travel, and give each tile an emoji and a name; a tile can also open a web page or an app link. There are Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Siri and Shortcuts actions, and a control for Control Center and the Action Button. Wheels sync through iCloud. The listing says it's a one-time purchase with no account, no ads and no data collected; it's made by P-Bon Consulting Services.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, $2.99 once
means: If you hunt through Home Screen pages for the same few apps, Orbit puts them on one wheel, a widget or the Action Button.
todo: Look at the screenshots on the App Store page first: it's a one-time $2.99 purchase with no free trial mentioned.
thumb_words: ORBIT: YOUR APPS ON A 3D WHEEL
